findings: Booking classification timezone mismatch — classifyBookings() parses journey dates in the browser's local timezone. A booking scheduled for 'today' server-time may appear as 'yesterday' client-time near midnight, causing misclassification. Prefer server-side classification or UTC timestamps with explicit timezone handling.

Guard synchronous check creates brief vulnerability window — The guard reads sessionStorage directly. If the backend session expired but sessionStorage still holds user data, the guard will pass, then the first API call will fail with 401. The interceptor will catch it and redirect, but the user sees a brief flash of the protected page.
